title: Blue Ridge Bankshares, Inc. Announces Share Repurchase Program
summary: Blue Ridge Bankshares, Inc. (the "Company") announced today that its Board of Directors has adopted a share repurchase program (the "Repurchase Program"). Pursuant to the Repurchase Program, the Company may purchase up to $15 million of the Company's issued and outstanding shares of common stock ("Common Stock"). Repurchases may be made in open market purchases, block trades, or privately negotiated transactions, including upon the exercise of outstanding warrants to purchase Common Stock. Open market purchases will be conducted in accordance with the limitation of Rule 10b-18 of the Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC"). Repurchases may be made pursuant to any trading plan that may be adopted in accordance with SEC Rule 10b5-1, which would permit Common Stock to be repurchased when the Company might otherwise be precluded from doing so under insider trading laws. Under applicable law, repurchased shares will be cancelled and revert to the status of authorized but unissued
